$comment: Personal-data register of fiorevera.hu (gdpr-guardian). Every form field, storage key, env endpoint, external host and browser signal in the code must be declared here with a purpose and the privacy-page key that explains it. Checked by .agent/skills/gdpr-guardian/scripts/audit-personal-data.ts (npm run audit:gdpr, and tests/unit/gdpr.test.ts inside npm test). inquiryPayload lists exactly the keys of the request sent to the form provider: the honeypot (website) and the consent flag are never sent. After any change here run `npm run audit:gdpr -- --seal`: it stamps today's date as version and updates data-register.seal.json. Keep in sync with docs/gdpr/newsletter-consent-concept.md section 1.
controller: Sebőkné Antalics Veronika (Fiore Vera), 8749 Zalakaros, Rózsa utca 53.

formFields.name: name
formFields.purpose: answer the inquiry, address the quote

formFields.name: date
formFields.purpose: wedding date: availability and quote; NOT reused for greetings without a separate consent

formFields.name: website
formFields.purpose: honeypot; must stay empty; dropped client-side, never sent

formFields.name: consent
formFields.purpose: mandatory consent flag for processing the inquiry (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a))

inquiryPayload.source: form field name; the key is the Hungarian label Vera reads in the delivered mail
form field phone (empty string when not given)
language of the page the form was sent from (hu/de/en); not typed by the visitor
form field email again, under the provider's reserved key: sets Reply-To of the delivered mail to the visitor
fixed mail subject plus the visitor's name
fixed sender label shown in the inbox
VITE_FORM_ACCESS_KEY (public Web3Forms key); sent only when configured

storage.purpose: language chosen by the visitor (consent-exempt preference, PRD D-4)
language toast dismissed (consent-exempt preference, PRD D-4)

env.name: VITE_FORM_ENDPOINT
env.purpose: form provider endpoint the inquiry is POSTed to
env.processor: Web3Forms, operated by Web3Creative (India); processor under its DPA v1.0 of 2026-07-13, which is part of its Terms; transfers under the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021/914); sub-processors AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner (EU), CleanTalk and Akismet (US, spam check on IP + e-mail); submissions kept up to 3 years on its side (30 days visible on the free plan) — read on web3forms.com/privacy and /dpa 2026-11-16; named on the privacy page since 2026-11-16

env.name: VITE_FORM_ACCESS_KEY
env.purpose: Web3Forms public access key sent with the inquiry

networkSinks.purpose: the only outbound request carrying personal data: inquiry → form provider → info.fiorevera@gmail.com

hosts.role: processor in use: Web3Forms form delivery (Web3Creative, India; SCC via its DPA — see env VITE_FORM_ENDPOINT)
not in use: alternative form provider kept in the CSP and in submitInquiry (US — transfer mechanism to confirm before any switch)

Vercel Web Analytics — wired 2026-11-12 via @vercel/analytics inject() in src/lib/analytics.ts, production mode, only on fiorevera.hu / *.vercel.app hosts; v2 loads the script and sends page-view beacons same-origin (/_vercel/insights/*), this host is the package's debug/fallback script origin kept in the CSP

hosting.purpose: serving the site: the CDN sees the visitor's IP address, user agent and the requested URL; runtime logs
hosting.retention: logs visible to the owner: 1 hour on Hobby (1 day on Pro) — vercel.com/docs/logs/runtime, read 2026-11-16
hosting.transfer: EU-US Data Privacy Framework: Vercel Inc. (Covina, CA) listed as Active for the EU-U.S. DPF, HR and non-HR data, on dataprivacyframework.gov/list (checked 2026-11-16); Vercel's DPA (effective 2026-03-31, SCC 2021/914) names Pro and Enterprise customers only — on Hobby there is no written processor contract [CONFIRM], so the privacy page does not claim one
hosting.lawfulBasis: legitimate interest in running the site securely (Art. 6(1)(f)) [CONFIRM]

outboundLinks.role: plain link to the Instagram profile; nothing is sent until the visitor clicks
plain link to the Facebook page; nothing is sent until the visitor clicks
plain link to Google Maps (address); nothing is sent until the visitor clicks
JSON-LD vocabulary URL, never requested by the browser

browserSignals.purpose: read once in an effect to suggest DE/EN; not stored, not sent (PRD D-4)
fallback for browsers without navigator.languages; same use, not stored, not sent
